card.title: Declare Allegiance
card.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

mechanism: A presses a collaborator to choose which rival claim to support despite an attempted compromise.
confusable: Unlike improving a proposal, A must resolve allegiance between named competing people.
comparison: D58-a tests whose claim B would correct; D58-b tests which election ribbon B will wear on voting day.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
